King Muhammad found himself in the same sterile white office he was in not a month ago. The fire had managed to be contained in the construction bay, so most people were still operating in an official capacity. The king closed the door behind him just loud enough to disturb Fahad.

"What? What is-" Fahad froze when he looked up. "Oh, it's you."

"Yes. It's me. We need to talk about the fire."

"What I said to the repo-"

"I'm not here about what you said to the journalists. If I had been upset about about that I would've come sooner. I'm here because the fire that destroyed the kinetic bombardment satellite was just discovered to be arson. Someone put the lives of our scientists and engineers at risk. I need your help discovering who."

"I will, uh, I will keep my ear to the ground."

"Good. Check anyone who appears to be disloyal to the team or to Saudi Arabia. In some countries what they did would be considered treason."

Fahad, becoming visibly angry "I'll be sure to check anyone whose loyalty has faltered."

"Good. I wish to catch this rotten swine so that I can give them what they deserve."

Fahad snapped. "Maybe they had a good reason! Maybe the thought of building something so terrible kept them awake at night because their name would always be attached to it as the person who led the project! Maybe I thought such a death machine would be unnecessary to fight a bunch of savage terrorists who think themselves a nation!"

"And so you did. But did you have to burn it? Why didn't you just leave?"

"I would have always been involved. I'm sorry my king. I'm so terribly sorry. Have me arrested, I deserve it."

The king stood silent for a moment. "No. I won't do that."

Fahad looked up at him. "What?"

"You're a good Muslim man. You're a great engineer, and a credit to the team. You're possibly one of the brightest minds in Saudi Arabia. While what you did was somewhat selfish in nature, you were concerned about the rest of the world's safety. It pains me that you would not trust me to be sparing with such a deadly machine, but your heart was in the right place. And you didn't hurt anyone. So I won't have you arrested."

"Thank you King Muhammad! I don't know what to say!"

"I don't believe there's much left to say. But I'm also afraid you cannot go unpunished. What you did would be considered treason by some countries. So. . . I have to let you go."

"What?"

"You burned about $300,000 worth of scientific equipment. You started a fire in the construction bay. I can't let that go unnoticed. I'm sorry, but you have to leave."

"I" Fahad sighed. "I understand."

"Do not let it trouble you though, I doubt you will be looking for work very long."

Alternate F1 is a AI-racing series simulated on the game Grand Prix 4, where we can be F1 team managers. Highlights of the races will be uploaded to youtube. There can be up to 11 teams, with 1 or 2 drivers per team. You can enter 1 team and/or 1 driver.

Creating a team

First, pick a team name, this can be any F1 team that has existed since 2000.

Each team starts with 100 credits to spend, which can be earned through prize money (more details on this later). A team can spend all 100 on their car for season 1, or save some for future seasons.

Then a team has to pick what they focus on for car development. A team can choose what percentage to focus on reliability (at the expense of speed), qualifying performance (at the expense of race performance) and downforce (at the expense of straight line speed).

An example of a team entry:

Team: McLaren

Credits spent on car development: 90

70% speed // 40% qualifying // 30% downforce

Creating a driver

Creating a driver is more simple, you just pick between qualifying and race performance, and speed against consistency, the same way as it worked with teams.

I'll use your voat username as the in-game driver name unless you want me to use something else.

An example of a driver entry

20% qualifying // 60% speed

If you want to enter a team/driver, or if you have any questions about how this works (not sure if I explained it that well), leave it in the comments! :D
